aiSummary: 今日聚焦国际政治领域。热点议题包括：Iran instructs Houthis to prepare；Live updates: ‘Large and deadly’；Trump’s Board of Peace drops。本日共收录 10 条重要国际新闻。

articles.title: Iran instructs Houthis to prepare to close the Bab el-Mandeb Strait
articles.description: Iran reportedly told the Houthis to prepare to disrupt the Bab el-Mandeb, raising fears the terror group could choke Red Sea shipping.

articles.title: Live updates: ‘Large and deadly’ flood waves threatens Texas Hill Country
articles.description: Flash flood emergencies were issued for the region, where last year’s floods devastated the area, including Camp Mystic. Follow for live news updates.

articles.title: Trump’s Board of Peace drops full Gaza recovery plan in favour of tiny pilot scheme
articles.description: Revised plan aims to ‘keep something going’ amid fears Netanyahu may gamble on new all-out offensive before Israeli elections

articles.title: Estonia Expects Delayed US Arms Deliveries After Iran War Disruption
articles.description: Estonia's US arms deliveries, delayed by the Iran war, are expected in coming months, says Defence Minister Pevkur. Some weapons like ATACMS still pending.

articles.title: Political crisis and protests in Ukraine as Zelenskyy defends sacking defence minister
articles.description: President says he had to choose ‘one side or the other’ after breakdown of relations between ministry and military leaders

articles.title: Uncle of Ann Widdecombe suspect says he 'nearly fell to floor' over arrest
articles.description: The uncle of a man being held on suspicion of murder tells the BBC his legs "went like jelly" when he heard his nephew had been arrested.

articles.title: UK shuts down British Council offices in Tanzania
articles.description: The decision follows years of financial strain for the British Council, which uses cultural exchange, education and English language programmes to build relationships while delivering UK-funded develo

articles.title: Canada suspends new parent, grandparent visa sponsorships
articles.description: Decision reflects broader shift in immigration policy after years of record admissions. Indians make up the largest immigrant group in country.

articles.title: 10 African countries with the strongest military in 2026
articles.description: Nigeria has been ranked as the third-strongest military power in Africa in the 2026 Global Firepower Index, behind Egypt and Algeria.

articles.title: Hungary Releases List of 2 African Countries Whose Citizens Can Enter Without Visa in 2026
articles.description: The government of Hungary has announced the only two African countries whose citizens qualify for a visa-free entry. Options for other nations were also explained.
